title: 1997 contact: 10,000 people paid $10 million each

tellings.quote: who said, "We have given at least 10,000 people $10 million each or more to secure their cooperation with what we're doing."

plain: In 1997 in Washington, someone told Steven Greer that at least 10,000 people had each been paid $10 million or more to make sure they cooperated with a hidden effort. Greer, who says he was there, repeats the line on the show as he says he heard it: "We have given at least 10,000 people $10 million each or more to secure their cooperation with what we're doing." If it were true, it would mean that secrecy about UFOs has been bought on a huge scale.
